description: This file contains the implementation of the PHPMailer class, a PHP class for sending emails via sendmail, PHP mail(), or SMTP, including methods for composing, encoding, and attaching email content.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A PHP class for composing and sending emails via sendmail, SMTP, or PHP mail() with support for attachments, encoding, and headers.

methods.name: IsHTML
methods.description: Sets the message content type to HTML or plain text.

methods.name: IsSMTP
methods.description: Configures the class to send email via SMTP.

methods.name: IsMail
methods.description: Configures the class to send email using PHP mail() function.

methods.name: IsSendmail
methods.description: Configures the class to send email via sendmail.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Creates and sends the email message using the configured mailer.

methods.name: SendmailSend
methods.description: Sends email using the sendmail program.

methods.name: MailSend
methods.description: Sends email using PHP's mail() function.

methods.name: SetLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for error messages.

methods.name: AddrFormat
methods.description: Formats an email address with optional name.

methods.name: SetMessageType
methods.description: Determines message type based on attachments and body.

methods.name: AttachAll
methods.description: Builds MIME parts for all attachments.

methods.name: EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string in specified encoding.

methods.name: AddStringAttachment
methods.description: Adds a string as an attachment.

methods.name: InlineImageExists
methods.description: Checks if inline images are present.

methods.name: IsError
methods.description: Checks if an error has occurred.
